name: vscode-flowpact
description: Diagnostics, hover traces and go to definition across GitHub Actions workflow calls: inputs, secrets, outputs and matrices checked as you type.
author: Ruman Kazi

untrustedWorkspaces.description: flowpact plugins run JavaScript from the repository, so they load only in trusted workspaces. Everything else works in Restricted Mode.

virtualWorkspaces.description: flowpact reads workflow files from disk.

flowpact.plugins.markdownDescription: Load the [plugins](https://rumankazi.github.io/flowpact/docs/custom-rules) the flowpact config lists. They run JavaScript from the repository, so they never load in an untrusted workspace, whatever this setting says.

enumDescriptions: Compare with the committed contracts when `.github/flowpact/contracts/` exists.
Always compare with the committed contracts.
Never compare with the committed contracts.
flowpact.contracts.markdownDescription: Report [contract](https://rumankazi.github.io/flowpact/docs/contracts) drift and breaking interface changes (`FP801`–`FP805`), as `flowpact check` does.

enumDescriptions: Hide them in files open in the editor while the GitHub Actions extension is running, which reports the same problems there.
flowpact.overlappingRules.markdownDescription: `FP502`–`FP505` (expression syntax, schema, YAML syntax and context availability) repeat checks the [GitHub Actions](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=GitHub.vscode-github-actions) extension makes.

flowpact.hiddenRules.markdownDescription: Rule codes not to show in the editor, e.g. `FP604`. To turn a rule off everywhere (CLI and CI too), set it to `off` in the flowpact config instead.

flowpact.trace.server.markdownDescription: Trace the messages between VS Code and the language server. Shown in the flowpact output when its log level is Trace (**Developer: Set Log Level…**).
